title: Guard project environment notices against network-path resolution on shared writers
outcome: Missing-environment notice discovery uses the existing network-path boundary so one unresponsive network workdir cannot stall the shared Codex writer.
acceptance: Reuse the existing network-path guard or existing off-writer declaration discovery owner for prompt notices; preserve current local and named-root notice behavior and names-only diagnostics.

A deterministic fixture demonstrates that a guarded network workdir does not enter blocking root discovery while normal local notice behavior remains covered; no real network timeout waits or new path owner.
